name: What should I do first if my drywall looks rough or uneven after mudding?
description: Check the high spots, seams, corners, and screw holes first. Sand light imperfections, but if a section is deeply uneven, add more joint compound and sand again

mainEntity.name: What should I do first if my drywall looks rough or uneven after mudding?

acceptedAnswer.text: Start by checking the seams, corners, screw holes, and any high spots, then sand the roughest areas first and finish with lighter passes. If an area is deeply uneven, add a thin coat of mud instead of trying to force it flat with sandpaper.
acceptedAnswer.description: Check the high spots, seams, corners, and screw holes first. Sand light imperfections, but if a section is deeply uneven, add more joint compound and sand again after it dries.
